children: US craft beverage maker's Q3 net sales fell 7% yr/yr on lower volumes with national customers
Gross profit rose 34% and gross margin improved to 25% from 17% yr/yr
Company refinanced $9.25 mln loan and closed $10 mln private placement after quarter end
Company expects sequential operating improvements in coming quarters
Reeds aims to expand gross margins and maintain cost discipline
Company continues to focus on strengthening sales execution and expanding retail coverage
LOWER VOLUMES - Co said net sales decline was primarily due to lower volumes with recurring national customers
GROSS MARGIN GAINS - Co attributed higher gross margin to lower promotional and other allowances and reduced cost of goods per case
COST CONTROL - Co said selling, general and administrative expenses fell due to ongoing efforts to optimize costs, partly offset by investment in Asia growth initiative
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
